history.title: Our History
history.subtitle: Eternal Life Ministry in Honduras & Beyond
history.paragraph1: God placed the vision in the hearts of missionaries Víctor Solórzano and Doris Hernández to establish Eternal Life Ministry in Honduras.
history.paragraph2: During volunteer work alongside their son Javier, they witnessed firsthand the healthcare hardships and severe poverty facing local families. Moved by God's love, they began serving children through medical clinics and the transformative gospel of Jesus Christ.
history.paragraph3: Answering God's call, missionaries Fernando and Glenni joined the mission, pouring life into the work and mentoring a dedicated youth team to carry the message of hope to the next generation.
history.gallerySubtitle: Moments of worship, fellowship, and Bible study
history.purposeText: To equip and inspire churches, youth, teachers, and families to effectively fulfill the Great Commission.
history.missionText: To proclaim the good news of Jesus Christ, reach the lost with the message of salvation, and build up believers through biblical truth and God's love.
history.visionText: Rooted in sound biblical doctrine, we nurture disciples who live out honesty, integrity, and holiness in every aspect of life.
